Why this is a fresh check

The candidate and reference checkpoints, seed 300, baseline window 50 and primary metric were recorded before downloading or scoring J03WR9. Candidate: rnn-capacity-002-1layer-experimental.npz. Current model: rnn-boundary-001.npz. Training used J03WOH; validation used J03WPY. No fitting or tuning occurred on this match.

What remains uncertain

  • One previously unused match; not proof of statistical significance or general superiority.
  • Fortuna Düsseldorf appears in training and validation, so clubs are not fully unseen.
  • This match is now viewed; no parameter tuning may be justified as fresh-test selection.
  • Simulated missing ball observations do not reproduce all competition tracking errors.
  • No prediction was compared against challenge video or challenge truth.

Models remain frozen. The default is not automatically replaced by this report.
